answer.summary: Identify a single, narrow research question to evaluate non-linguistic indicators of temporal state persistence in scientific preprints beyond linguistic or citation-based proxies.
answer.content: Propose a focused inquiry into the presence and structure of persistent state variables in the mathematical formulations of arXiv preprints 2409.15678 to 2409.19876, specifically examining equations that define recurrent or time-dependent state updates, such as differential equations with memory terms or recursive update rules, without relying on metadata or citation networks. Document any such patterns with positional and syntactic context and assign confidence based on explicit mathematical structure alone.
